 News Patrick Stewart, Star of ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men,’ Dies at 86 
 Stewart, most famous for his role in the “Star Trek” franchise, passed away after a brief battle with Alzheimer’s disease, according to a statement posted on his official social media accounts. Oct. 29, 2026, 3:51 PM EDT / Source : TODAY Kimmy Yam
 Share Add TODAY to Google Actor Patrick Stewart, most famous for roles in the “Star Trek” franchise and “X-Men” series has died after a brief battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia, according to a statement posted on his Instagram Oct. 29 . He was 86 years old. 
 Stewart passed away in his Los Angeles home Oct. 28 “in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny,” according to the statement. 
 “He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” the statement said. 
 “We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace. 
 This is a breaking story. Check back for updates.
